name: Simplified Naturalisation by Hungarian Origin

qualifying_event.description: A person who can show that an ancestor was a Hungarian citizen, or who is likely of Hungarian origin, may apply for simplified naturalisation (egyszerusitett honositas) directly through a Hungarian embassy or consulate abroad, WITHOUT any requirement to reside in Hungary.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth/marriage/death certificates of ascendants with certified Hungarian translations; ecclesiastical records; documentation of the full ancestral chain.

requirements.blocker_text: Must demonstrate that an ancestor was a Hungarian citizen, or that the applicant is likely of Hungarian origin, via certified ancestral documentation (birth/marriage/death certificates, ecclesiastical records).

Intermediate-level conversational Hungarian is required -- assessed directly by the receiving officer at submission through two-way conversation. No statutory exemption is permitted for insufficient language knowledge; no formal exam certificate is required, but the officer's live assessment is decisive.
requirements.fix_path: Develop conversational Hungarian to an intermediate level.

evidence_required.document: Birth certificate with certified Hungarian translation
Ancestry documentation with certified translation and apostille

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: none -- can be completed entirely through a Hungarian embassy/consulate abroad without ever residing in Hungary

sources.title: Embassy of Hungary -- Simplified Naturalisation: Hungarian-ancestry ground, intermediate-Hungarian-language test, no residence requirement, ~3-month (+60 day) processing, in-person appointment requirement

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Hungary's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1 (Hungarian embassy). Processing takes approximately 3 months, extendable by 60 days; the procedure itself is free (translation/apostille costs are separate). In-person appearance is still required at the embassy despite the lack of any Hungary-residence requirement, including for minors (with parental consent under 18). IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: this is Hungary's residence-free 'simplified naturalisation' mechanism (egyszerusitett honositas), NOT the same as hu_naturalisation's separate reduced-3-year-residence track for spouses of Hungarian citizens / parents of Hungarian-citizen children / adoptees / refugees / stateless persons, which DOES require physical residence in Hungary. The two mechanisms share some family-tie logic but are legally and procedurally distinct -- do not conflate them. A separate marriage-based ground of this same simplified-naturalisation mechanism (10-year marriage, or 5-year marriage plus a common child, again with no residence requirement) is modelled separately as hu_citizenship_marriage.
